## FEATURES.md

- [ ] User-facing capability changed → `FEATURES.md` updated (New / Changed / Removed, plus plan gating if it changed)
- [ ] No capability change (refactor, copy, style, tests) → label `skip-features-md` or `[skip-features]` in the title

CI fails if capability files change without `FEATURES.md`. See `FEATURES.md` for the catalog.
